Live preview stress note A synthetic note that uses every Markdown construct the editor has to show. Nothing in it is personal. Edit anything: the text you see is the document, and the status bar names every change. Inline formatting Plain text with emphasis, underscore emphasis, strong, underscore strong, both at once, struck through, and inline code. Code with a backtick inside: a`b. Nested: strong with emphasis inside and emphasis with code inside. Escapes keep markers literal: *not emphasis*, _not either_, # not a heading, [not a link], a backslash \ and a pipe |. Entities: & © — <tag>. A hard break with two trailing spaces and one with a backslash then the paragraph goes on. Unicode: naïve café, 日本語, emoji 🌿, and right-to-left עברית. Headings Third level Fourth level with a closing sequence Fifth level Sixth level Setext heading, level one Setext heading, level two Links An inline link, a reference link, a collapsed reference, an autolink https://example.org, a bare URL https://example.net/page and an email someone@example.com. Page links: [[Getting started]], [[Project plan|the plan]] and [[Notes/Sub page]]. Square brackets that are no link: [just text] and [x]. Lists First bullet Second bullet with strong text Nested bullet Third level bullet Fourth level Back to the second level Third bullet that is long enough to wrap onto a second line when the editor is narrow, so wrapping inside list items can be checked. Below the rules. Images An inline PNG gradient in the middle of a sentence. Footnotes A sentence with a footnote[^1] and another[^long]. [^1]: The first footnote. [^long]: A longer footnote with formatting and a second, indented line. HTML Markdown inside an HTML block. Inline HTML: Ctrl + S, H2O and x2.
